alerts.desc:
For the following areas...
Tidal Potomac from Key Bridge to Indian Head MD...

At 404 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 18 nm northwest of Tidal Basin to 15 nm west of Key
Bridge to 24 nm northwest of Leesylvania State Park, moving east at
35 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts in excess of 48 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Observed wind.

IMPACT...Boaters could easily be thrown overboard by suddenly higher
wind and waves capsizing their vessel. Boats could suffer
significant damage in high winds.

Tidal Basin, Fort Washington, Reagan
